name: Code stats
description: Lines of code in each project's local checkout, split into code, tests, comments and docs, with its languages. Counted from the files git tracks and cached; a project file shows them where it has a code-stats block.
author: Vaultite

code-stats.description: a project's lines of code in its local checkout, split into code, tests, comments and docs, and its languages
code-stats.live: the project's checkout on this machine (git)

languages.description: how many of its languages to show (0 hides them)

project.description: another project than the file's (its name)
